evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 5.2 ppm at the end of the ramp, following a stable low-oxygen baseline.
Oxygen rose to 13.5 ppm upon entering growth.
Oxygen continued increasing to 38.3 ppm during growth.
Oxygen reached 54.5 ppm, a sustained rise despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Temperature 749.4 °C and argon flow 100.6 sccm track their setpoints; heater power is 44.7% and status remains running, neither explaining nor excluding the oxygen anomaly.
No pressure gauge is installed; pressure telemetry cannot discriminate an exhaust restriction from other causes.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and checks of seal integrity and exhaust patency/pressure are needed to distinguish air ingress, exhaust restriction, or sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
